strings.hydro.privacy-mode-text: Panel aur console mein server ke IP address aur port chhupata hai. Chhupe hue mann par cursor le jaayein to woh dikhega. Is browser mein save hota hai.
strings.hydro.shortcuts-intro: Text field ke bahar panel mein kahin bhi ye keys dabayein. Ye list dekhne ke liye kabhi bhi ? dabayein.
strings.hydro.shortcut-tabs: Maujooda server ka n-wa tab kholein
strings.hydro.shortcut-search: Search ya server selector par focus karein
strings.hydro.shortcut-privacy: Privacy mode on ya off karein
strings.hydro.language-text: Chunein ki theme ka text kis bhasha mein dikhe. Is browser mein save hota hai.
strings.hydro.forcibly-stop-alert: Server ko force se stop karna data corruption ka reason ban sakta hai.
strings.panel.add-a-public-key-to-sign-in-to-sft: Bina password ke SFTP se sign in karne ke liye ek public key jodein.
strings.panel.create-a-key-to-use-the-client-api: Apne scripts aur tools se client API istemal karne ke liye ek key banayein.
strings.panel.manage-your-profile-credentials-an: Apni profile, credentials aur khate ki suraksha manage karein.
strings.panel.reinstalling-your-server-will-stop: Server dobara install karne par woh band ho jayega aur phir wahi installation script dobara chalegi jisne use shuru mein set kiya tha.
strings.panel.schedules-run-commands-power-actio: Schedules commands, power actions aur backups apne aap chalate hain.
strings.panel.some-files-may-be-deleted-or-modif: Is process mein kuch files delete ya modify ho sakti hain, aage badhne se pehle apna data backup karein.
strings.panel.this-server-doesn-t-have-any-datab: Is server mein abhi koi database nahi hai.
strings.panel.this-server-doesn-t-have-any-netwo: Is server ko koi network allocation nahi diya gaya hai.
strings.panel.we-re-having-some-trouble-connecti: Aapke server se judne mein dikkat aa rahi hai, kripya intezaar karein...
strings.panel.your-sftp-password-is-the-same-as-: Aapka SFTP password wahi hai jo aap is panel ko access karne ke liye istemal karte hain.
strings.arix.account.api-key.all-requests-invali: Is key se chalne wali saari
strings.arix.account.api-key.allowed-ips-descrip: Kisi bhi IP ko is API key use karne dene ke liye khaali chhodo, warna har IP ko alag line par likho.
strings.arix.account.api-key.label: Description
strings.arix.account.api-key.no-key-found: Is account ke liye koi API keys nahi mili.
strings.arix.account.api-key.store-save: Aapki mangi hui API key niche dikh rahi hai. Isse kahin safe jagah par save kar lo, baad me dobara nahi dikhegi.
strings.arix.account.appearance.title: Appearance
strings.arix.account.recovery-tokens-dialog.aler: Ye codes dobara nahi dikhaye jayenge.
strings.arix.account.recovery-tokens-dialog.desc: Niche diye gaye codes ko kahin safe jagah par likh lo. Agar aapka phone kho jaye to in backup codes se sign in kar sakte ho.
strings.arix.account.ssh-key.create-form.public-: Apni public SSH key yahan daalo.
strings.arix.account.ssh-key.delete-form.will-in: SSH key ko delete karne se iska use poori tarah se band ho jayega.
strings.arix.account.ssh-key.no-key-found: Is account ke liye koi SSH keys nahi mili.
strings.arix.account.twofactor-messagebox: Aage badhne ke liye aapke account par 2-factor authentication on hona chahiye.
strings.arix.account.twofactor.disable-dialog.mu: Aage badhne ke liye aapko apne account ka password daalna hoga.
strings.arix.account.twofactor.is-disabled: Aapke account par abhi 2-factor authentication on nahi hai. Niche diye gaye button se ise setup karo.
strings.arix.account.twofactor.is-enabled: Aapke account par abhi 2-factor authentication on hai.
strings.arix.account.twofactor.setup-dialog.desc: Upar dikh raha QR code apni pasand ki 2-factor app se scan karo. Phir niche field me 6 digit ka code daalo.
strings.arix.account.twofactor.setup-dialog.ente: Aage badhne ke liye 6 digit ka code aur apna password daalo.
strings.arix.account.twofactor.setup-dialog.qrco: QR code load hone ka wait ho raha hai...
strings.arix.account.twofactor.title: Two-factor authentication
strings.arix.account.update-email.is-updated: Aapka email successfuly update ho gaya.
strings.arix.account.update-password.requirement: Aapka naya password kam se kam 8 characters ka ho aur is website ke liye unique ho.
strings.arix.activity.no-logs-server: Is server ke liye koi activity logs available nahi hain.
strings.arix.auth.device.enter-one-of-recovery-c: Aage badhne ke liye is account ke 2-factor setup ke waqt bane hue recovery codes me se koi ek daalo.
strings.arix.auth.device.enter-two-factor: Apne device se generate hua 2-factor token daalo
strings.arix.auth.device.title: Device checkpoint
strings.arix.auth.forgot.a-valid-email-provided: Aage badhne ke liye ek valid email dena zaroori hai.
strings.arix.auth.forgot.email-description: Password reset ke instructions paane ke liye apne account ka email address daalo.
strings.arix.auth.forgot.title: Password reset ka request
strings.arix.auth.login.must-be-provided: Username ya email dena zaroori hai.
strings.arix.auth.login.please-enter-password: Please apne account ka password daalo
strings.arix.auth.login.title: Aage badhne ke liye login karo
strings.arix.auth.register.success-message: Aap successfuly register ho gaye, apna email check karo
strings.arix.auth.register.title: Create an Account
strings.arix.auth.register.username-taken: Yeh username already use ho raha hai.
strings.arix.auth.register.valid-username-requir: Valid username required hai (3-16 characters, sirf letters, numbers, dashes aur underscores).
strings.arix.auth.reset.at-least-8-characters: Aapka naya password kam se kam 8 characters ka hona chahiye.
strings.arix.auth.reset.password-does-not-match: Aapka naya password match nahi kar raha.
strings.arix.auth.reset.title: Password reset karo
strings.arix.dashboard.all-servers-you-have-acce: Yahan aap sab servers dekh sakte ho jinke liye aapke paas access hai.
strings.arix.dashboard.there-are-no-servers: Dikhane ke liye koi aur server available nahi hai.
strings.arix.dashboard.there-are-no-servers-asso: Aapke account se koi server linked nahi hai.
strings.arix.navigation.at-least-three-character: Please search start karne ke liye kam se kam 3 characters daalo.
strings.arix.navigation.enter-name-uuid-allocati: Search start karne ke liye server ka naam, UUID ya allocation daalo.
strings.arix.utilities.forcibly-stopping-alert: Server ko force se stop karna data corruption ka reason ban sakta hai.
strings.arix.utilities.low-resources-desc: Aapka server resources par kam chal raha hai, yeh serious ho sakta hai, please apna plan upgrade karo.
